cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I withdrew my college application. Have you told Mum?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No. I told her you were still deciding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't replace my silence with a plan I haven't made. I've leased a bakery. Can I send you the address?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Call me. Mum uses my tablet; she'd see the message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take the call somewhere you can stay alone. It's Mum's old bakery.

reason: Give A a real correction of B's protective but inaccurate account, then let B's good privacy contribution earn the most sensitive disclosure without making B foolish.
